SELECT p.id,p.code,p.name_zh,p.scope,p.grantable_to_tenants,p.resource_code,p.status FROM iam.permissions p WHERE p.scope='tenant' AND p.grantable_to_tenants AND p.status='active' AND (p.resource_code IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam.tenant_entitlements te JOIN iam.resource_catalog rc ON rc.code=te.resource_code WHERE te.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND te.resource_code=p.resource_code AND te.status='active' AND rc.status='active')) ORDER BY p.sort,p.code
